decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the drawing numbered D_11_21GPR_001 submitted on the 5th April 2011 and drawing numbered D_11_21GPR_002 Rev.C submitted on 23rd May 2011 and drawing numbered D-11_21gro_005  submitted on 26th May 2011 therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - Conservation area consent is required for the demolition of the front boundary wall because it is over 1m high.  Conservation area consent is required prior to the demolition of the front boundary wall.

Condition : 5 - All excavations in preparation of foundations and all works above ground level in the immediate vicinity of  trees to be retained shall be carried out in a manner to ensure that all major roots that are uncovered shall be retained and foundations bridged around them, and all major branches shall also be retained unless the Local Planning Authority otherwise agrees in writing; such works to be carried out to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of new front wall and gates to the house.
